promise: The I Promise School will open in Akron in fall 2018 — 'the most important thing I'll ever do' (as reported).
description: LeBron opened the I Promise School in his hometown Akron on July 30, 2018, pledged to keep it funded and to expand it. He added a second I Promise School in 2023 and a third in 2025, and has continued funding college scholarships for students.
evidence: I Promise School opened 2018-07-30 for at-risk students
Expanded: second school opened Aug 2023, third Aug 2025; ongoing funding commitments
